metadata.source: ours: BDSP Grand Underground Mysterious Shard farming loop. Starts outdoors or inside the Grand Underground

checkpoint.title: Farm Mysterious Shards and treasures in the Grand Underground

events.why: transit to the Grand Underground if outdoors, refresh Hideaway doorways, route and lock onto sparkling walls, play the mining minigame until the slates or cycles goal is reached, auto-save, and leave the Underground
